The '''MD-8 medical droid''' was a model of [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] and a part of the [[MD-series medical droid/Legends|MD-series]] that was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. Like the company's [[MD-7 medical droid|MD-7]] and [[MD-9 medical droid|MD-9]] models, the MD-8 was a prototype medical droid used only in limited sectors.<ref name="EGTD" />
